comment_structure_height: Only structures whose bounding box bottom (minY) is inside this range are processed.
comment_floating: Automatic detection of flying structures (airships, planes) and ships at sea: a structure is skipped when at least 'Floating column ratio' of its footprint has more than 'Floating air gap' blocks of air below it, or when 'Water column ratio' of its footprint stands on water. A jigsaw structure placed at an absolute height (no project_start_to_heightmap) counts as an extra hint; optionally terrain_adaptation=none does too.
comment_shell: Shell settings format: "modid:structure_file": { radius, verticalOffset, exponentialSpeed }
comment_lists: Id lists support: full id (modid:name), namespace.*, *, #modid:tag. Structure blacklist: never processed. Foundation blacklist: template files (.nbt) of pieces whose structure is never processed. Force list: always processed, ignoring the blacklist and the automatic floating/water/underground detection.
comment_templates: The list of structure template files known to the server is written to structure_generation_improver.templates.txt at every start.
